items.title: CATCH-UP (never alerted): Kharge, Ramesh escalate SIR fight — Kharge accuses Shah of branding ~13.3 crore Indians 'infiltrators'; Ramesh dubs SIR 'Shah Instigated Removal'
items.summary: CATCH-UP: these Oct-14 statements fell through the cracks of that day's runs and were never alerted. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge posted on X accusing HM Amit Shah of insulting Indian identity by describing the ~13.3 crore people allegedly excluded by SIR as 'infiltrators'; he condemned the Jantar Mantar protest curbs ('First vote theft, then theft of the right to protest'), accused the BJP of an authoritarian agenda, and accused the government of shielding CEC Gyanesh Kumar. Jairam Ramesh (two X posts) dubbed SIR the 'Shah Instigated Removal' and posed three questions to Shah: how many infiltrators were detected, deleted, and deported after ~100 crore Indians went through SIR — asking whether the government suggests 14 crore Indians are infiltrators. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav issued a poetic 'One voice of One India' X post against alleged electoral fraud. Context: Shah on Tuesday (Oct 13) had said the opposition should be ready for a 'crushing defeat' in 2029 and claimed the country could see through Rahul Gandhi's 'plan' to get infiltrators registered as voters.
